newsitem.title: USA: Bradlees gets extension to file plan.
newsitem.headline: Bradlees gets extension to file plan.

text.p: Bradlees Inc said Tuesday that the US Bankruptcy Court granted a six month extension of the company's right to exclusively file a plan of reorganization.
Bradlees said the extension for the reorganization plan, to be filed with the court, will facilitate the company's continuing efforts to restore profitability.
The company said it will continue to "move forward with modifications to (its) merchandising and advertising programs and cost structure" to help the company return to profitability.
Bradlees said the decision was supported by the company's creditor constituencies.
